name: Days with an inch or more of rain
title: Days with an inch or more of rain in {city}, {SS}
alt: Chart of days per month with at least one inch of rainfall in {city}, {SS} — the stretch that backs up a condensate drain and floods an outdoor unit. {summary}
captions: {city} averages about {total} a year with an inch or more of rain, most often in {peak}. A downpour that heavy is what overwhelms a condensate line or floods a ground-mounted outdoor unit faster than the pump can clear it.

Roughly {total} of heavy rain fall on {city}, {SS} each year, peaking in {peak}. Standing water around an outdoor condenser or heat pump in that stretch is what drives corrosion and electrical faults years earlier than normal.
Heavy-rain days in {city} cluster around {peak}. That is when drainage around outdoor equipment gets tested hardest, and when a clogged condensate line finally backs up into the system.
